_comment: First-time teaching cards (see include/Tutorial.h): the world stops and hones in on a mechanic the FIRST time it happens. Events are emitted by the game's tutorial pump at the moment the thing is on screen, one per line kind plus the surfaces: `observation` (a chosen reading), `impression` (a pressed one -- the senses took it unbidden), `remark` (speech), `thought` (a thought lands), `deed_menu` (the deed menu first opens), `spirit` (a line that earned Spirit is up). Cards sharing an event show in this order. `focus` names the hud region left lit: content / notification; omit for a full dim. The card itself always parks in the upper band, clear of the content. One card, once per pilgrim, Space dismisses. Words are a first draft.

cards.title: Impressions
cards.body: Not everything waits to be looked at. A sound, a light, a voice -- the senses take the world in whether you choose it or not.

cards.title: Observing
cards.body: Walk up to what glows and press Space to look. What you notice reads out here -- Space turns the page and lets it go.

cards.title: Deeds
cards.body: This is what can be done here. W and S to choose, Space to do it. Some deeds only open once you know more.

cards.title: Thoughts
cards.body: Something you took in just became a thought. Thoughts arrive on their own, out of what you have seen and who you are becoming.

cards.title: The Notebook
cards.body: Every thought is written down with its moment, and can be read back any time. They are yours to build on.

cards.title: Remarks
cards.body: Words said aloud -- yours or another's -- wear quotes. What is said passes; only thoughts are written down.

cards.title: Spirit
cards.body: Noticing and doing lift your spirit. It gathers as you walk -- what it becomes is yours to discover.
